description: Copies community entries from one of the developer's apps into another: each becomes a new entry of the developer's in the target, live at once. Authors, votes, favorites, reviews and reports are not copied, and running it twice duplicates. The target's community must be on; its rules apply. More: neblla_get_llms tools/copy_community_entries

appId.description: The target app, which gets the copies.

entryIds.description: Only these entries; left out, every published one (up to 500).

name: neblla_copy_community_entries
title: Copy community entries between apps
